title: Hearing on immigrant pregnancy and birth health outcomes
summary: The Council's Immigration, Health, and Women and Gender Equity committees held a joint oversight hearing on pregnancy and birth-related health outcomes among immigrants in New York City. The hearing also considered a bill barring the use of city resources to enforce restrictions on reproductive care. Testimony examined disparities in prenatal care, maternal mortality, insurance coverage and language access affecting the city's roughly 3.1 million immigrant residents.
